versions.description_html:
Nerdio Manager can run a PowerShell script for you, at the right moment and without anyone logging in to a machine. This episode explains what scripted actions are, when they run, what people automate with them and how to keep them safe.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a scripted action actually is in Nerdio Manager
  • The difference between Windows scripts and Azure runbooks
  • When a scripted action runs
  • What admins typically automate with them
  • Where the scripts come from
  • How to keep scripted actions safe and avoid the mistakes that bite people

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
